title: Turmeric Salmon Quinoa Bowls
steps: Rinse the quinoa, simmer it in twice its volume of water for 15 minutes, then spread it on a tray to cool.
Rub the salmon with 1 tablespoon olive oil, the turmeric, and the black pepper. Roast at 400F for about 12 minutes, until it flakes.
Divide the cooled quinoa and the spinach between four containers.
Add a piece of salmon to each, then the blueberries and pumpkin seeds.
Dress with the remaining olive oil and a squeeze of lemon just before eating.
storageNotes: Refrigerate up to 3 days. Reheat the salmon and quinoa gently at low power; add the spinach, blueberries, and pumpkin seeds cold afterward so they keep their texture.
goldenRuleCallouts: Naturally gluten-free as written; any add-in must be certified GF.
Fatty fish plus turmeric with black pepper: the anti-inflammatory anchor of the week.
Pumpkin seeds carry the crunch here, so this bowl needs no tree nuts at all.
